description: Operational view of test-case feed health, book freshness, bounded channels, latency, and signal outcomes.

panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Current scrape, exchange connectivity, and whether both books are usable for signal evaluation.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape
panels.description: Prometheus target health. No series means Prometheus has not discovered this target.

panels.title: Feeds connected
panels.description: 1 means the WebSocket is connected. This does not mean a usable book has been published.

panels.title: Books usable
panels.description: Current application readiness for each selected exchange book.

panels.title: Process started at
panels.description: Start time of the process reported by the Linux process collector. Empty when the collector is unavailable.

panels.title: Book freshness and input timing
panels.description: Snapshot age is derived from the published receive timestamp. Feed age distinguishes transport silence from a lack of accepted market updates.

panels.title: Published book age at scrape
panels.description: Age of the published snapshot at the timestamp of its latest successful Prometheus scrape, derived from the local received_at timestamp. This is not a live current age; scrape intervals limit its update frequency. Initial zero timestamps are excluded. Use the Prometheus scrape card (up) for target availability.

panels.title: Feed input ages at scrape
panels.description: Age at the latest successful Prometheus scrape for the most recent transport frame and accepted valid snapshot. These are not live current ages; scrape intervals limit their update frequency. Initial NaN timestamps are absent. Use the Prometheus scrape card (up) for target availability.

panels.title: Signal input age percentiles
panels.description: Quantiles from observed classic histogram buckets; no observations in the 5 minute window yields no series.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(signal_input_age_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Signal input skew percentiles
panels.description: Absolute receive-time difference of the two snapshots used by each evaluation. No synthetic zero is emitted when an input is missing.

panels.title: Ingestion, errors, and recovery
panels.description: Rates show completed events. Retry exhaustion may be followed by process exit before another scrape can collect its final increment; target down remains visible.

panels.title: Depth message outcomes
panels.description: Accepted, duplicate, outdated, wrong-symbol, and invalid depth messages. Control frames are omitted from this market-data chart.

panels.title: Feed errors and reconnect reasons
panels.description: Fixed, bounded error and disconnect labels. Rates automatically handle process counter resets.

panels.title: Connection attempts and retry exhaustion
panels.description: Connection attempts per second use the left axis. Retry exhaustions over the preceding 15 minutes use the right count axis; Prometheus extrapolation may yield fractional counts. The final exhaustion count may be missed when the application exits immediately.

panels.title: WebSocket payload throughput
panels.description: Application payload bytes yielded by WebSocket; excludes TCP/TLS overhead.

panels.title: Channels and message loss
panels.description: Each bounded queue is shown separately. Loss is failed sends divided by successful sends plus failed sends; intervals with no sends have no ratio.

panels.title: Queue depth and capacity
panels.description: Queue depth is sampled periodically; brief peaks can be missed. Capacity is configured message count.

panels.title: Channel send and receive rates
panels.description: Successful nonblocking sends compared with messages actually removed by the receiver.

panels.title: Channel send loss ratio
panels.description: Full and disconnected failures divided by all attempted sends. No ratio is returned when the window has no sends.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (channel) (rate(channel_send_failures_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) / (sum by (channel) (rate(channel_sent_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum by (channel) (rate(channel_send_failures_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) and on (channel) ((sum by (channel) (rate(channel_sent_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum by (channel) (rate(channel_send_failures_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) > 0)

panels.title: Send failures by channel and reason (last 15m)
panels.description: One row per channel and send-failure reason. Values are Prometheus increase estimates over the preceding 15 minutes; boundary extrapolation can yield fractional values. Counters reset safely across process restarts.

panels.title: Book depth levels
panels.description: Number of currently stored bid and ask levels; level count alone does not imply book usability.

panels.title: Book validation errors
panels.description: Snapshots rejected by the book task for the wrong symbol or invalid row data. Feed parser and transport errors remain in the feed error chart.

panels.title: Processing latency and ping RTT
panels.description: Application time families are exported in nanoseconds and scaled to milliseconds here. Process collector metrics retain their standard units.

panels.title: Processing duration percentiles
panels.description: Parse, book-update, and signal calculation work, excluding queue wait. Quantiles are computed from classic buckets over five minutes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (stage) (sum by (stage) (rate(processing_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Frame-to-published-book latency percentiles
panels.description: Transport frame receipt through parsing, queueing, and publication, by exchange.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(book_update_latency_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Ping RTT percentiles
panels.description: RTT is measured only for a matching Pong on the current connection.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange) (sum by (exchange) (rate(feed_ping_rtt_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Connection duration percentiles
panels.description: Successful and failed connection/subscription attempts, with reconnect waiting excluded. Fifteen minute window for sparse attempts.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange, result) (sum by (exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange, result) (sum by (exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_bucket{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m]))) / 1e6 and on (exchange, result) (sum by (exchange, result) (rate(feed_connection_duration_nanoseconds_count{job="$job",instance=~"$instance",exchange=~"$exchange"}[15m])) > 0)

panels.title: Spread directions and Hold outcomes
panels.description: Spreads are raw gauge values in basis points. NaN and absent observations remain gaps. The horizontal comparison line comes from the running process threshold gauge.

panels.title: Cross-exchange spread by direction
panels.description: A spread is present only while the inputs produce a valid calculation. The orange series is read from the running app configuration, not a dashboard constant.

panels.title: Signal outcome rates
panels.description: Both directional outcomes and each fixed Hold reason; a missing rate means no event in the selected window.

panels.title: Process resources
panels.description: The built-in process collector is registered only on Linux. Resource panels intentionally remain empty on platforms where those standard process metrics are unavailable.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: Standard Prometheus process collector metric: CPU seconds per second. Unavailable on non-Linux builds.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: Standard Prometheus process collector metric. Unavailable on non-Linux builds.

panels.title: Process restarts (24h)
panels.description: Changes to process start time observed by Prometheus over 24 hours. This is scrape-based and only available where the collector is registered.
